review: Pretty okay Tremor ID. Yurodivy Ryoshu's clashing is absolutely abysmal without her conditionals, those clashes being 11/13/13, which can prove problematic since she can gain a lot of Tremor Count with her S1 (maximum of 6), which fulfills all conditionals of her S2, but also consumes at maximum 5 Tremor Count, so it'll be harder to reach her S3 conditional. Although with those conditionals, they rest at an okay 13/17/19. All in all she's pretty clunky to use on field and would be an absolute nightmare to use in fights where the enemy has actually competent rolling skills. Most of usefulness does come from her passiveness, which even then would only mostly be good in mob fights that, again, she'd struggle in. Her support passive is great for Yurodivy Hong Lu though.
